name: J. C. Copeland
role: Billings County justice of the peace
bio: J. C. Copeland was elected a Billings County justice of the peace in April 1886 on the first county ticket, and his bond was accepted by the commissioners that May. Through 1886 the paper reported cases in his court, including a property dispute, a jury case brought by Ferris & Merrifield, a man fined $15 for firing a revolver in town, and the Territory's case against Gregor Lang. In November 1886 a J. A. Copeland was awarded the contract to enclose the county jail building.
